Simanim 331-332 • The Laws of Terumot and Ma'asrot, and Ma'aser Sheni, and Leket and Shikhcha and Pe'ah Since these laws are not practiced at all in this time, and the halachot are numerous, and they have no connection with the book of Yoreh De'ah; and since the book of Yoreh De'ah even without them is of great quantity and great quality, I have therefore refrained from writing them here. We have arranged these halachot in the laws that are not practiced in this time.
